decision: Use native generateShadow1 projection for all seven environment map PNG animations. Preserve real painted material/contact shade. Do not fabricate or install empty shadow sidecars.
authorization: Coordinator explicitly chose option B after inspected native consumer evidence; the four separately owned service sites will use the same policy.

consumer_evidence.behavior: Only HERO and BOAT use a fixed draw slot.
Other objects split into layers; getShadowAnimation at442–445 requests ONLY_SHADOW.
For ONLY_SHADOW, generateShadow0 appends -SHADOW; generateShadow1 loads original PNG and invokes drawShadow at505–506.
SDL2 has the equivalent shadow selection and -SHADOW branch at422–436.

source_art: All actors/objects remain original painted2D. Native 2D alpha projection is renderer compositing, not a 3D artwork production dependency.
limit: Source inspection and compiler memory-plan replay prove declared loader branch/resource intent only. Actual native projection, ground contact and possible doubled material/contact shade remain unobserved and require native pixel review.
